title: passages.json
description: Input file for scripts/holdout_split.py. A list of qualifying passage IDs to split into kept and masked sets for the held-out projection test. The script accepts either the wrapped object form or a bare array. At least 4 IDs are required — below that no meaningful set can be held out.

items.description: A stable passage id, e.g. 'p001'. Passage ids are yours to assign during Stage 1; keep them stable so the split stays auditable across runs.
